# infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace (Resource)

Manages an Infoblox Ipv6DhcpOptionspace in both NIOS and UDDI backends.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Create an IPv6 DHCP Option Space with Basic Fields
resource "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "ipv6_dhcp_option_space_with_basic_fields" {
  nios = {
    name              = "example_option_space_1"
    enterprise_number = 5473
  }
}

// Create an IPv6 DHCP Option Space with Additional Fields
resource "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "ipv6_dhcp_option_space_with_additional_fields" {
  nios = {
    name              = "example_option_space_2"
    enterprise_number = 5473
    comment           = "Example Ipv6 Option Space"
  }
}
```

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Create an IPv6 DHCP Option Space with Basic Fields
resource "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "example" {
  uddi = {
    name = "example_option_space_1"
  }
}

// Create an IPv6 DHCP Option Space with Additional Fields
resource "infoblox_ipv6_dhcp_optionspace" "example_with_options" {
  uddi = {
    name = "example_option_space_2"

    //Other Optional Fields
    comment = "IPv6 DHCP option space"
    tags = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `nios` (Attributes) NIOS backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios))
- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The reference to the object.

<a id="nestedatt--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nios`

Required:

- `enterprise_number` (Number) The enterprise number of a DHCP IPv6 option space object.
- `name` (String) The name of a DHCP IPv6 option space object.

Optional:

- `comment` (String) A descriptive comment of a DHCP IPv6 option space object.


<a id="nestedatt--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uddi`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the option space. Must contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.

Optional:

- `comment` (String) The description for the option space. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the option space in JSON format.

Read-Only:

- `protocol` (String) The type of protocol for the option space (_ip4_ or _ip6_).
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
